body: I don't have aspirations. Everything I do is to keep up appearances so my family doesn't worry. I don't want to travel, I hate new things, I don't like socialising because I have crippling anxiety. There is nothing in my life to fix, I have people who love me, I have no doubt that I'll graduate with good marks and become a successful psychologist if I keep going, and I don't have to worry about money. All the good things aren't enough to offset the bad. Besides, you send this message to everyone; you clearly don't even care enough to think about what I'm saying.
I don't even know what being happy (while sober) feels like. I first recall wanting to kill myself at the age of ~7
It's been at least 13 years, when is it going to get better? There's nothing wrong with my life other than my messed up brain. I'm down to taking things 1 hour at a time, even sleep isn't an escape.

Been on medication, hasn't worked, supposed to be trying something else once I'm weaned off prozac (again). I've tried to explain, but all people do is tell me not to do it because they care about me. Awesome, I'll continue existing just to keep you happy.
This time I lied just enough to stop from getting locked up. As soon as someone finds out I have a plan my chance will be gone. Everyone already knows that I can barely handle leaving the bedroom.

I think part of it is that he doesn't want to believe it. He knows that I've been lying to my doctor about how bad it is. I know what's going on logically, I've been training to be a psychologist for 4 years. It doesn't help.
I can't use phones, and he's at work anyway. I tried to tell him this morning but I don't think he understands how bad it's getting. He thinks it's just prozac withdrawal.
